summary: Phase 9 RemedialFlow rate-editor sheet UX fix verified end-to-end at 390x844 (admin). The Sheet now accepts dismissOnBackdrop=false (src/ui.tsx:162-185) which (a) wraps the modal in react-native-keyboard-controller KeyboardAvoidingView with behavior=padding on iOS / height on Android, (b) renders statusBarTranslucent + navigationBarTranslucent, (c) uses an outer Pressable whose onPress is Keyboard.dismiss (NOT onClose) so taps on the backdrop AND on non-interactive sheet chrome dismiss only the keyboard, (d) exposes an explicit X close button (testID {sheet}-close) in the sheet header, and (e) scrolls content in a ScrollView with keyboardShouldPersistTaps='handled' plus maxHeight 90% so inputs + Save/Cancel remain reachable. project/[id].tsx:180 passes dismissOnBackdrop={false} to the rate-sheet only; project-actions-sheet, add-nc-sheet and audit-sheet still use the default (close-on-backdrop). closeRate() dismisses the keyboard, clears any inline error and nulls rateFor; saveRate() validates on client (regex /^d+(.\d{1,2})?$/, >0 and <=100000) before calling PUT /api/projects/{id}/rates/{iid}, catches API errors and sets rateErr WITHOUT closing the sheet, and only closes on 2xx. UI tests at 390x844 (admin @ TEST-P9DUAL-74D7DB) all PASS (20/20): rate-sheet opens from rate-edit-{iid}; backdrop tap keeps sheet open with rate-input=160 and rate-reason-input='backdrop test' preserved; tap on non-interactive area inside sheet (title row) keeps sheet open and preserves input; rate-save with 'abc' / '12.345' / '' each surfaces testID=rate-error and leaves sheet open (no API call); rate-cancel and rate-sheet-close both close WITHOUT saving (rate-value-{iid} unchanged); page.route forced PUT /api/projects/*/rates/* -> 500 surfaces rate-error='forced failure' and keeps sheet open with 170 + 'fail test' preserved; valid save (160) closes sheet and updates rate-value-{iid} to '£160.00 per job · Earned, unpaid £160.00'; revert to 400 restores original text. REGRESSION: project-actions-sheet still closes on its backdrop-tap (default); audit-sheet still closes on its backdrop-tap. BACKEND regression: cd /app/backend && EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=... python -m pytest -o addopts='' tests/test_p9_rates.py -q = 19 passed (same P9 contract: validation ladder, rate_history append, earning amount update, 409 on paid, rate_rows visibility, admin-only guard, notifications, audit). The web preview cannot emulate a real soft keyboard so native keyboard-overlap behaviour must still be confirmed on device by the user; the code uses the required react-native-keyboard-controller KAV so the ergonomics are correctly set up. One minor pre-existing deprecation warning noted in console: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' originating from src/ui.tsx:214 (toast) and app/camera.tsx:78,79 - unrelated to this fix, non-blocking.

rca_of_issue: Original user bug: in the admin per-project rate editor on mobile (1) the soft keyboard covered the rate-input / Save Rate button and (2) tapping outside input closed the entire modal, discarding typed values. ROOT CAUSE: src/ui.tsx Sheet always rendered the backdrop Pressable with onPress={onClose} and did not wrap the modal in a KeyboardAvoidingView; the sheet also lacked a scrollview, so when the native keyboard appeared it covered the bottom third of the sheet (including Save/Cancel). FIX: added dismissOnBackdrop prop; when false (used by rate-sheet) the backdrop Pressable's onPress is Keyboard.dismiss (NOT onClose), the whole modal is wrapped in react-native-keyboard-controller KeyboardAvoidingView (padding iOS / height Android) with statusBarTranslucent + navigationBarTranslucent, an explicit X close button is rendered in the sheet header, and the content is placed in a ScrollView with keyboardShouldPersistTaps='handled' and maxHeight 90% so inputs + Save + Cancel can always be reached by scrolling. project/[id].tsx closeRate guards against mid-save close, and saveRate preserves rateFor + rateText + reason on both validation failures and API errors, closing the sheet only on 2xx. VERIFIED on web preview @ 390x844: backdrop tap does not close sheet; typed values survive; validation + API-500 both show rate-error inline and keep sheet open; Cancel / X close without saving; valid save closes + updates row + toast; other sheets still close on backdrop (regression safe). Native keyboard overlap behaviour requires user confirmation on real device because the Expo web preview cannot emulate a soft keyboard.
